prompt: Create ONE production-ready wide horizontal sprite sheet for Sekigahara Ranbu: exactly four separate full-body frames of Sanada Yukimura's unarmed idle loop, arranged left-to-right in a single row with generous blank gaps and no borders. Each pose is a different frame of the same character at identical scale, facing screen-right in a low ready stance. Match the approved Yukimura setting art: Japanese warrior in his thirties, stern rugged face, black hair, red kabuto with gold six-coin crest and distinctive antler-like gold side ornaments, rich red lacquered lamellar armor over black sleeves, red shoulder guards, white waist sash, dark brown hakama, red shin guards, straw sandals, flowing red cape. Remove the banner, spear, swords and every other weapon completely. Both hands are visibly empty, closed fists in the exact ready gripping pose: right fist forward, left fist back, as if a long weapon could be overlaid later. Keep face, armor, colors, proportions and body scale identical. Frame 1: compact guard stance. Frame 2: slight inhale, chest and shoulders lift by a few pixels. Frame 3: subtle exhale, elbows settle, cape edge shifts gently. Frame 4: returns close to the opening guard while still visibly a distinct frame. Loopable idle only, no stepping, no attack, no jump, no kneeling. Both feet stay planted on one common ground line at about 90% of cell height. Each complete figure including helmet ornaments, cape, hands and sandals fits inside its own quarter of the canvas; no pose or cape overlaps an adjacent pose. Professional painterly Japanese historical action game sprite art with confident ink contours, layered rich red and charcoal shading, warm gold armor details, realistic anatomy, clean edge separation. Background is perfectly flat opaque RGB pure magenta #FF00FF edge-to-edge, no texture, no shadows outside the small footprint under each pose. No text, calligraphy, captions, UI, scenery, extra people, aura, motion trails or decorative effects. Create one candidate only.
